The IDX's retail-investor base is increasingly rotating from banks to consumer small-caps, a liquidity shift that historically sustains multi-month rallies in this sector when US rates hold.
sectors.ai: Buy the consumer/FMCG momentum now: the +1.59% aggregate with broad-based small-cap surges (BRRC +31%, COIN +25%) signals a risk-on rotation into domestic consumption names, not a one-off. Front-run Q3 earnings by adding exposure to palm-oil-linked consumer plays (BWPT, PGUN) and packaged-food names (EL, FOLK) before foreign funds chase the ID/US spread. Trim only if the IDX consumer index breaks below its 20-day moving average.
